rendering_notes: The packed scenes are self-contained Blender reference assemblies. The generators additionally depend on the retained local224/226 library and their recorded input scenes.

GLBs omit cameras and lights by design. Exact Blender camera, studio/world, exposure, color management and Cycles/ray-visibility settings are in fixtures235.json; those scene effects are not automatically carried by GLB.

Thin clear lenses use alpha blending without transmission/refraction. A nearest-opaque portrait compositor still needs a separate transparent-surface comparison; triangle reduction does not solve that.

Preserve shared coordinates, component/material selection and color roles. Supply ordinary GLBs first; no compression/quantization is introduced. Regenerate portrait color and depth together after geometry or camera changes.
Use source235 -> optimized derivative -> native rendering -> lightweight portrait comparisons. No native parity, phone workload benchmark, or catalogue-wide runtime acceptance is claimed.
